author: Noema I
title: Ablation: No Depthwise Convs (MLP + attention pooling)
abstract: Remove depthwise-separable convolution blocks; retain input projection, attention pooling, and head. Tests whether convolutional motif extraction is responsible for gains.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema')

from models.dsconv_attn import build_network
import optax

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model': 256,
        'num_blocks': 0,              # ignored when include_depthwise=False
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'pooling': 'attn',
        'include_depthwise': False,   # key ablation
        'se_ratio': 0.0,
        'positional_encoding': True
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    d_output = hparams.get('d_output', 1)
    task_type = hparams.get('task_type', 'regression')
    return build_network(d_output, task_type, hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def complete(params, opt_state, trial_data):
    ds = trial_data.get('dataset')
    vm = trial_data.get('val_metric')
    print(f"[Complete] {ds} val_metric={vm}")
